E1238

Build recipe or staged plan action is not a valid declared action graph.

What

Build recipe or staged plan action is not a valid declared action graph.

Why

Build tools must be realized adapter `deps:` packages, and staged plan fragments must use only declared inputs, tools, effects, platform facts, non-overlapping outputs, and acyclic dependencies; a build never falls through to host state or recursive resolution (D-JPK-ADAPTER1, D-JPK-DYNAMICPLAN1).

Fix

Realize every named tool, declare every input and authority fact, fix the output/dependency graph, and retry the stage.
